_comment: Bug 35: these tables have RLS enabled with no client policy on purpose. They are read/written only via API routes using the service role (which bypasses RLS). Adding client policies would open direct-write paths that bypass API business logic, so deny-all to clients is the correct secure state. The rls_enabled_no_policy INFO lints for them are therefore acceptable.
